title: Warren Buffett & Berkshire Hathaway’s 2026 Annual Meeting: Part 2 5/3/26

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Warren Buffett discusses the current investing environment and market gambling at his 61st annual meeting.
reader_summary.overview: This episode features Warren Buffett speaking as an audience member at his 61st Berkshire Hathaway annual meeting. He shares his thoughts on today's investing environment. He also comments on the widespread gambling happening in financial markets.

key_points.text: Buffett weighs in on the current investing environment and comments on rampant gambling in markets today.
key_points.evidence_quote: He weighs in on the current investing environment, and he comments on rampant "gambling" in markets today.

notes: In the second of three special episodes from the Berkshire Hathaway 2026 Annual Shareholder Meeting, Becky Quick sits down with the Oracle of Omaha himself, chairman Warren Buffett. It’s Buffett’s 61st meeting, but it’s his first as a member of the audience. He weighs in on the current investing environment, and he comments on rampant “gambling” in markets today. For more Berkshire Hathaway coverage: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/02/warren-buffett-berkshire-hathaway-annual-meeting-2026-live-updates.html For past Berkshire Hathaway annual shareholder meetings: https://buffett.cnbc.com/annual-meetings/ Hosted by Simplecast, an AdsWizz company.
